context: Checks whether the final artifact follows the generate-status-report instructions from the published agnostic-planning-skills plugin.

checklist.name: instruction-1
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Produce a clear, honest status report. Focus on progress, blockers, and what's next.

checklist.name: instruction-2
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Rule:** Never fabricate progress — mark unknowns as "needs update."

checklist.name: instruction-3
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Write Executive Summary** — 2-4 sentences: health, key accomplishment, top concern.

checklist.name: instruction-4
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Review** — verify no status is fabricated or assumed.
